minutes.headline: ZBA granted a garage and a landscaping-business permit and car shows; outdoor seating was withdrawn.
minutes.summary: The board heard four matters. It granted a special permit for a 20x24 garage at 43 the Clearing, granted special permits for a landscaping contractor at 1259 Massachusetts Avenue, and approved Sunday car shows at the Prime Time Pub with a car limit and a police-detail condition. The outdoor seating request was withdrawn without prejudice because members said they lacked detail on fencing, exits, smoking and alcohol rules.

public_comment.topic: Property owner spoke in favor of the landscaping business buying his property.

votes.motion: Grant the special permit for a 20x24 garage with 8 ft rear and 4 ft side setbacks.
Grant the special permits requested for the landscaping business, with Board of Health and planning board review as a condition.
Strike the variance request and substitute a special permit for dimensional variation as to frontage.
Allow the petitioner to withdraw without prejudice and bring back car shows and outdoor seating separately.
Allow Sunday car shows with a limit of 36 display cars and the police chief having final say on a detail.
Accept the withdrawal without prejudice of the outdoor seating request.

budget_items.what_was_said: The chair said the fee already paid would be waived if the applicant resubmits.
Members estimated the cost of a police detail the owner might have to pay for the car shows.
The applicant said a cut-through door would cost too much for a rented building.

decisions.decision: Car shows limited to Sundays, 4 to 9 p.m., June to September, 36 display cars, police chief decides on a detail; motorcycles allowed.
Outdoor seating withdrawn without prejudice; fee waived on resubmittal; applicant to return with fencing, exit and ABC/Selectmen details.

what_happened.line: The board granted a special permit for a 20x24 garage at 43 the Clearing, with reduced rear and side setbacks, on a 5-0 vote.
Special permits for a landscaping contractor at 1259 Massachusetts Avenue were moved with Board of Health and planning board review as a condition; the vote count was not audible.
Sunday car shows at the Prime Time Pub were moved with a display-car limit and the police chief deciding on a detail; the vote count was not audible.
The outdoor seating request was withdrawn without prejudice, with the fee waived on resubmittal and fencing, exit and licensing details to come.

why_it_matters: These permits set what can operate at each site: a new garage close to property lines, a landscaping business on Massachusetts Avenue, and weekly evening car events at a pub, with any police detail cost falling on the owner.
Outdoor seating at the pub is not approved, so any change would need a new hearing where neighbors can comment.
